sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: discogs.com, with the "Import Discogs releases to MusicBrainz" userscript (murdos) installed: every Discogs table whose rows are releases, masters, artists or labels gets a "MusicBrainz" column right after Title or Name — the master's versions, a release's Credits, Companies and Other versions, an artist's discography, a label's releases, a submissions list and a user's lists. Each cell shows, on one line, every MusicBrainz entity linked to that Discogs page (the entity icons that script puts on Discogs' own page only), a yellow search box for each kind without one, a grey icon for an ended link and a count from two links up. A company is first looked for as a MusicBrainz place (a studio, a pressing plant), as that script does. The links come from that script's own cache first (read only, its data is never changed), then from this script's own store, then from MusicBrainz in the background, 100 Discogs links a request, one request a second; a header button (▶ MB) shows the progress and asks again for failed rows, and so does a click on a failed row's ⚠. Settings: "MusicBrainz column (with the Discogs importer userscript)" and "MusicBrainz column: look up missing rows automatically", both on. Without that userscript nothing changes. Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/6CmnUoNf4LHd44yxvp3rvu

📊 dropdown on that column: a "MusicBrainz - Links" section with the number of MusicBrainz links per row (» MB links: 0, 1, 2, …) and, while rows are still looked up or failed, "pending" and "error"; a ticked entry rings the matched icons and keeps up as answers arrive.
